name.Description: Contact name; matched to the EDF channel label (leading zeros) where a unique match exists

anat_label.Description: DKT (antspynet) label within 2 mm, deposit ieeg_recon module3 *atlas-DKTantspynet_radius-2_desc-vox_coordinates.csv

tissue_atropos.Description: Atropos tissue class, deposit ieeg_recon module3

region_coarse.Description: Coarse region from anat_label (NEMAR enrichment, report/ieeg-atlas/build/regionmap.py); derived, not in the deposit

atlas_label_aal3_coarse.Description: AAL3 lookup of the MNI coordinates (report/ieeg-atlas/build/coord_regions.py), coarse region; derived, not in the deposit

native_T00mri_x.Description: Coordinate in the pre-implant MRI (T00mri) space, deposit ieeg_recon module2 *_space-T00mri_desc-mm_electrodes.txt
